in_english.name: Manahilun
in_english.meaning: the views that attract the sight of others
in_english.long_meaning: The name Manahilun is derived from the Arabic root مَناهِل, which means 'views' or 'sights'. In Islamic tradition, Manahilun refers to the beautiful and pleasing views that attract the sight of others. It is also associated with the concept of guidance and direction, as one who sees the Manahilun is guided towards the right path. In Arabic, the long meaning of Manahilun is 'المَناهِلُ الَّتي تَستَقبلُ المَنظرينَ', which translates to 'the views that attract the sight of others'. In Urdu, the long meaning is 'وہ مَنظَرے جن پر دیکھنے والے آتے ہیں', which translates to 'the views that attract the sight of others'. In Hindi, the long meaning is 'वह मानभाव जो देखने वाले को आता है', which translates to 'the views that attract the sight of others'. In Pashto, the long meaning is 'هغه منظر چې د ګوروټو ته راتړي', which translates to 'the views that attract the sight of others'.
